When I talk about immigration and when I talk about illegal immigration and all the problems

sentences.zh: 2016年2月，他和特朗普在阿拉巴马州的一场集会上。

sentences.en: I told Donald Trump, this isn't a campaign.
sentences.zh: 我告诉唐纳德·特朗普，这不是一场竞选。

sentences.en: This is a movement.

sentences.en: He is the first major national politician to endorse Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他是第一位支持唐纳德·特朗普的主要国家级政治家。

sentences.en: And politicians have promised for 30 years to fix illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 30年来，政客们一直承诺要解决非法移民问题。

sentences.en: Have they done it?

sentences.en: Donald Trump will do it.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普会做到的。

sentences.en: And a bond is formed.
sentences.zh: 由此建立了一种纽带。

sentences.en: Mike Schmidt covers national security for the Times.
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特为《时报》报道国家安全新闻。

sentences.en: This is a new relationship for Trump.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普来说是一段新的关系。

sentences.en: This is not someone that he has known from his time in New York.
sentences.zh: 这不是他在纽约时认识的人。

sentences.en: This is not someone he knows from real estate.
sentences.zh: 这不是他在房地产界认识的人。

sentences.en: This is a national politician latching onto him and saying, we need to make America great again.
sentences.zh: 这是一个国家级政客紧紧抱住他的大腿并说，我们需要让美国再次伟大。

sentences.en: I identify with your politics.
sentences.zh: 我认同你的政治立场。

sentences.en: I am going to try and get you elected president.
sentences.zh: 我要努力让你当选总统。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: And for Jeff Sessions, it was that closeness, that relationship, that ultimately led to his demise.
sentences.zh: 对杰夫·塞申斯来说，正是这种亲密关系，最终导致了他的垮台。

sentences.en: And Mike, why did Jeff Sessions endorse Donald Trump so early?
sentences.zh: 迈克，为什么杰夫·塞申斯这么早就支持唐纳德·特朗普？

sentences.en: What does that tell us about Sessions?
sentences.zh: 这向我们透露了关于塞申斯的什么信息？

sentences.en: It tells us what the issue of immigration means to Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 这告诉我们移民问题对杰夫·塞申斯意味着什么。

sentences.en: He had been a true hardliner on this issue.
sentences.zh: 他一直是这个问题的真正强硬派。

sentences.en: He had pushed things on immigration that were not widely accepted in the Senate as the senator from Alabama.
sentences.zh: 作为阿拉巴马州参议员，他在移民问题上推动了一些在参议院并未被广泛接受的事情。

sentences.en: And he sees Trump, who has made this issue a tenant of what he is running on, and he goes directly to him.
sentences.zh: 他看到了特朗普，后者将这个问题作为其竞选纲领的核心，于是他直接投奔了特朗普。

sentences.en: So they bond over a shared passion for cracking down on immigration.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们因对打击非法移民的共同热情而结缘。

sentences.en: Sessions sees Trump as someone in the Republican Party who is pushing the ideology on this issue that he has wanted to be at the front of the party's policies for a long time.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯视特朗普为共和党内的一个人，他正在推动这个问题的意识形态，而塞申斯长期以来一直希望这种意识形态处于党内政策的前沿。

sentences.en: And he goes straight for it.
sentences.zh: 于是他直奔主题。

sentences.en: Listen, this is a historic election.
sentences.zh: 听着，这是一场历史性的选举。

sentences.en: If we don't fix the immigration broken system now, it will not be fixed.
sentences.zh: 如果我们现在不修复破碎的移民系统，它就永远不会被修复。

sentences.en: This may be our last chance.
sentences.zh: 这可能是我们最后的机会。

sentences.en: And what becomes of the relationship between Trump and Sessions as the campaign intensifies?
sentences.zh: 随着竞选活动的深入，特朗普和塞申斯之间的关系会变成怎样？

sentences.en: What does Sessions' role become?
sentences.zh: 塞申斯的角色会变成什么？

sentences.en: What you have to understand about Donald Trump's run for president is that so few establishment Republicans,
sentences.zh: 你必须明白，关于唐纳德·特朗普竞选总统，极少数建制派共和党人、

sentences.en: Republicans in Congress, wanted to embrace his campaign.
sentences.zh: 国会中的共和党人，想要支持他的竞选。

sentences.en: What's his name?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 哈？

sentences.en: Senator Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 参议员杰夫·塞申斯。

sentences.en: You love Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 你很喜欢杰夫·塞申斯。

sentences.en: He's doing a good job.
sentences.zh: 他干得不错。

sentences.en: And what Sessions did is he got in so early with Trump, he benefits and he rises.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯所做的是，他很早就加入了特朗普阵营，他因此受益并崛起。

sentences.en: We have him very busy watching the borders.
sentences.zh: 我们让他非常忙碌地守卫边境。

sentences.en: A lot of things are happening.
sentences.zh: 许多事情正在发生。

sentences.en: He's one of the top people out there on the campaign trail for Trump.
sentences.zh: 他是特朗普竞选活动中最重要的人物之一。

sentences.en: Does Donald Trump have the determination, the will, to put America back on the right track again?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是否有决心、有意志让美国重回正轨？

sentences.en: He gets a big position in May of 2016.
sentences.zh: 他在2016年5月获得了一个重要职位。

sentences.en: He's named Trump's top foreign policy advisor.
sentences.zh: 他被任命为特朗普的顶级外交政策顾问。

sentences.en: And this is where the trouble begins for Sessions.
sentences.zh: 这就是塞申斯麻烦开始的地方。

sentences.en: As Trump's top foreign policy advisor, he comes into contact with a highly problematic person.
sentences.zh: 作为特朗普的顶级外交政策顾问，他接触到了一个问题极大的人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The Russian ambassador, Sergei Kislyak.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯大使谢尔盖·基斯利亚克。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Kislyak ends up roping Sessions into the vast saga that is the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 基斯利亚克最终把塞申斯卷入了俄罗斯调查这场巨大的传奇中。

sentences.en: After Trump is elected and after Sessions is nominated as attorney general.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普当选后以及塞申斯被提名担任司法部长之后。

sentences.en: In Sessions' confirmation hearing, he says he had no contacts with Russians during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 在塞申斯的确认听证会上，他说自己在竞选期间没有与俄罗斯人进行任何接触。

sentences.en: Shortly after that, it's reported by The Washington Post that Sessions had indeed met with Kislyak.
sentences.zh: 在那之后不久，《华盛顿邮报》报道称，塞申斯确实与基斯利亚克会面过。

sentences.en: And it is in the aftermath of that disclosure that Sessions decides to publicly announce.
sentences.zh: 正是在这一消息披露后，塞申斯决定公开宣布。

sentences.en: I have now decided to recuse myself from any existing or future investigations of any matter relating in any way to the campaigns for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我现已决定回避任何与美国总统竞选有任何关系的现行或未来调查。

sentences.en: That he will recuse himself from the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 即他将回避俄罗斯调查。

sentences.en: And remind us why he suddenly has to do that.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们，他为什么突然必须这么做？

sentences.en: There's two reasons.
sentences.zh: 原因有两个。

sentences.en: One, there are questions about whether he has provided misleading testimony to Congress about his contacts with the Russians.
sentences.zh: 第一，对于他是否就与俄罗斯人的接触向国会提供了误导性证词存在疑问。

sentences.en: And two, he had been a Trump campaign surrogate.
sentences.zh: 第二，他曾是特朗普竞选团队的代理人。

sentences.en: And the campaign was under investigations for its links to Russia.
sentences.zh: 而该竞选团队正因与俄罗斯的联系而受到调查。

sentences.en: And here's a guy who was actually talking to Russians during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 而这家伙在竞选期间实际上还在与俄罗斯人交谈。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the Senate Judiciary Committee will hold confirmation hearing for Rod Rosenstein for Deputy Attorney General, who, if confirmed,
sentences.zh: 周二，参议院司法委员会将为副司法部长提名人选罗德·罗森斯坦举行确认听证会，如果得到确认，

sentences.en: would take over the investigation into Russian interference in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他将接管对俄罗斯干预美国大选的调查。

sentences.en: election.
sentences.zh: 选举。

sentences.en: And not long after Rosenstein takes over the investigation, the president fires the FBI director, James Comey.
sentences.zh: 就在罗森斯坦接管调查后不久，总统解雇了联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米。

sentences.en: And Jeff Sessions was sitting in the Oval Office with Donald Trump in May of 2017 when they were both told that Rosenstein, who was supposed to be at the meeting they were at,
sentences.zh: 2017年5月，杰夫·塞申斯与唐纳德·特朗普坐在椭圆形办公室里，当时他们都接到通知：本该出席他们所在会议、

sentences.en: but was back at the Justice Department, had appointed Mueller as the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 但当时在司法部的罗森斯坦，已经任命穆勒为特别检察官。

sentences.en: And that's where it gets even worse.
sentences.zh: 事情变得更糟糕了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: What happens is that Trump unloads on Sessions and berates him like Sessions has never been berated before.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是，特朗普对塞申斯大发雷霆，痛骂了他，塞申斯从未受过这样的痛骂。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what is the president berating Sessions over?
sentences.zh: 总统究竟在为塞申斯的什么事情大发雷霆？

sentences.en: Of everything that haunts Donald Trump at night, this is the original sin, the fact that Sessions recused himself.
sentences.zh: 在所有萦绕在唐纳德·特朗普梦魇中的事情里，这是原罪，即塞申斯回避了自己。

sentences.en: Trump sees it today and for the past year and a half as the most disloyal thing anyone around him has done.
sentences.zh: 特朗普今天以及过去一年半一直认为，这是他身边任何人做过的最不忠诚的事。

sentences.en: And if he hadn't have done that, Rosenstein never would have appointed Mueller.
sentences.zh: 如果他当时没有这么做，罗森斯坦绝不会任命穆勒。

sentences.en: Mueller and Sessions becomes emotional and he offers his resignation, leaves the White House, writes a resignation letter.
sentences.zh: 穆勒和塞申斯情绪激动，他提出了辞职，离开了白宫，写了一封辞职信。

sentences.en: It's brought over to the White House the next day and Sessions waits for it to be accepted by the president.
sentences.zh: 第二天，这封信被送到白宫，塞申斯等待总统接受。

sentences.en: And what happens?
sentences.zh: 结果怎么样？

sentences.en: The president doesn't accept it.
sentences.zh: 总统没有接受。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不？

sentences.en: The president's advisers had talked him out of the firing.
sentences.zh: 总统的顾问劝阻了他，打消了他解雇的念头。

sentences.en: They said, if you fire Sessions right after Mueller was appointed and right after you fired Comey, it will make your problems 10 times worse.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果你在穆勒被任命后、在你解雇科米后立即解雇塞申斯，会让你的问题严重十倍。

sentences.en: So instead of firing Sessions, what does the president do with him?
sentences.zh: 所以总统没有解雇塞申斯，而是对他做了什么？

sentences.en: He tries to hold on to the resignation letter as a way of having leverage over Sessions as if I can use this letter at any point to get rid of you.
sentences.zh: 他试图保留这封辞职信，以此作为对塞申斯的筹码，就好像我可以随时用这封信来摆脱你。

sentences.en: Eventually, the president's advisers get the letter from him and it's sent back to the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 最终，总统的顾问从他手里拿回了这封信，并被送回了司法部。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: In the meantime, even though he hasn't gotten rid of Sessions, he embarks on a campaign to undermine and attack him publicly.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，尽管他还没有除掉塞申斯，但他开始了公开破坏和攻击塞申斯的运动。

sentences.en: Trump tweeting.
sentences.zh: 特朗普发推文。

sentences.en: It comes in tweets.
sentences.zh: 这体现在推文中。

sentences.en: Attorney General Jeff Sessions has taken a very weak position on Hillary Clinton crimes.
sentences.zh: 司法部长杰夫·塞申斯对希拉里·克林顿的犯罪行为采取了非常软弱的立场。

sentences.en: And it comes in an interview in the Oval Office with us.
sentences.zh: 这发生在我们对他在椭圆形办公室的一次采访中。

sentences.en: Right after he gets the job, he recuses himself.
sentences.zh: 他一上任就回避了自己。

sentences.en: Is that a mistake?
sentences.zh: 这是一个错误吗？

sentences.en: Well, Sessions should have never recused himself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，塞申斯绝不应该回避。

sentences.en: Or he says on the record.
sentences.zh: 或者他在公开记录中说。

sentences.en: He should have told me before he took the job and I would have picked somebody else.
sentences.zh: 他应该在接受这份工作之前告诉我，我会挑选别人的。

sentences.en: I never would have made Jeff Sessions my attorney general if I knew he was going to recuse himself.
sentences.zh: 如果我知道杰夫·塞申斯会回避，我绝不会让他担任我的司法部长。

sentences.en: Even my enemies say that Jeff Sessions should have told you that he was going to recuse himself and then you wouldn't have put him in.
sentences.zh: 就连我的敌人都说，杰夫·塞申斯本该告诉你他要回避，那样你就不会让他上任了。

sentences.en: He goes after him.
sentences.zh: 他穷追不舍。

sentences.en: And Jeff Sessions should have never let it happen.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯本绝不应该让这种事发生。

sentences.en: He should have never recused himself.
sentences.zh: 他本绝不应该回避。

sentences.en: In interviews.
sentences.zh: 在采访中。

sentences.en: He took the job and then he said, I'm going to recuse myself.
sentences.zh: 他接受了这份工作，然后他说，我要回避。

sentences.en: So he made what I consider to be a very terrible mistake for the country.
sentences.zh: 所以他犯了我认为对国家来说非常糟糕的错误。

sentences.en: But you'll figure that out.
sentences.zh: 但你会搞清楚这一点的。

sentences.en: Anywhere that he can.
sentences.zh: 无论在什么地方，他都可以。

sentences.en: I told you before I'm very disappointed with the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 我之前就告诉过你，我对这位司法部长非常失望。

sentences.en: But he's in the position now.

sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: We will see what happens.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.zh: 时间会证明一切。

sentences.en: Time will tell.
sentences.zh: 时间会证明一切。

sentences.en: It's really interesting because even while Sessions knows that he's probably operating on borrowed time, and even while Trump is attacking him so relentlessly,
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为即使塞申斯知道自己的日子可能不多了，即使特朗普对他的攻击如此毫不留情，

sentences.en: Sessions is continuing to implement Trump's agenda.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯仍在继续推行特朗普的议程。

sentences.en: If you cross the border unlawfully, even a first offense, then we're going to prosecute you.
sentences.zh: 如果你非法越境，哪怕是初犯，我们也要起诉你。

sentences.en: And some of the most high-profile and controversial policies from the Trump administration are written out or articulated by Jeff Sessions, like family separation, for example.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府一些备受瞩目且极具争议的政策是由杰夫·塞申斯起草或阐述的，例如骨肉分离政策。

sentences.en: If you smuggle an illegal alien across the border, then we'll prosecute you for smuggling.
sentences.zh: 如果你走私非法移民过境，那我们就以走私罪起诉你。

sentences.en: If you're smuggling a child, then we're going to prosecute you.
sentences.zh: 如果你在走私儿童，那我们就要起诉你。

sentences.en: And that child will be separated from you, probably, as required by law.
sentences.zh: 而且这个孩子将与你分离，可能按法律规定如此。

sentences.en: Sessions' allies would say that out of all the cabinet members, Sessions was the most successful in implementing the president's agenda.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯的盟友会说，在所有内阁成员中，塞申斯在落实总统议程方面是最成功的。

sentences.en: If you don't want your child to be separated, then don't bring them across the border illegally.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想让你的孩子骨肉分离，那就不要非法带他们越过边境。

sentences.en: It's not our fault that somebody does that.
sentences.zh: 有人这么做并不是我们的错。

sentences.en: But none of this ends up changing Trump's mind that Sessions has to go.
sentences.zh: 但这些都无法改变特朗普认为塞申斯必须离开的想法。

sentences.en: Donald Trump and Jeff Sessions, I'm pretty sure, only spoke to each other in cabinet meetings in the aftermath of the Mueller appointment.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，在任命穆勒之后，唐纳德·特朗普和杰夫·塞申斯只在内阁会议上才互相说话。

sentences.en: The relationship, which had been born on the campaign trail,
sentences.zh: 这段关系诞生于竞选期间，

sentences.en: Trump's great political ally, who the president considered a close friend, the president will no longer speak to him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的伟大政治盟友，总统曾将其视为密友，总统将不再与他讲话。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订户，请今天就下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I rise today to speak to the issue of the leadership of the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 我今天起立发言，讨论司法部领导层的问题。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that Trump really wanted to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 尽管特朗普真的很想摆脱他。

sentences.en: It would be a very, very, very bad idea to fire the attorney general because he's not executing his job as a political hack.
sentences.zh: 解雇总检察长将是一个非常、非常、非常糟糕的主意，因为他没有作为政治傀儡来执行工作。

sentences.en: Republican senators came to Sessions' defense.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员站出来为塞申斯辩护。

sentences.en: That is not the job of the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 那不是总检察长的工作。

sentences.en: The attorney general's job is to be faithful to the Constitution and to the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 总检察长的工作是忠于宪法和法治。

sentences.en: He's been very loyal.
sentences.zh: 他一直非常忠诚。

sentences.en: He was the first, really for a long time, the only senator who supported the president.
sentences.zh: 他是最初的，而且在很长一段时间里，唯一支持总统的参议员。

sentences.en: If you look at so much of what the president of the United States wants to accomplish on his agenda,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看美国总统想要在他的议程上完成的许多事情，

sentences.en: Sessions is central to that.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯是其中的核心。

sentences.en: And they say if you do this, it will only make the questions about whether you are trying to obstruct the Russia investigation worse.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果你这样做，只会让关于你是否试图阻挠通俄调查的质疑变得更加严重。

sentences.en: This effort to basically marginalize and humiliate the attorney general is not going over well in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 这种基本上边缘化和羞辱总检察长的努力在参议院并没有受到好评。

sentences.en: I don't think it's going on over well in the conservative world.
sentences.zh: 我认为它在保守派世界里也没有受到好评。

sentences.en: If Jeff Sessions is fired, there will be holy hell to pay.
sentences.zh: 如果杰夫·塞申斯被解雇，将会有极其严重的后果。

sentences.en: Any effort to go after Mueller could be the beginning of the end of the Trump presidency unless Mueller did something wrong.
sentences.zh: 任何针对穆勒的行动都可能是特朗普总统任期走向终结的开始，除非穆勒做了错事。

sentences.en: And Trump listens to that.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普听进去了。

sentences.en: He has terrible scar tissue from the firing of Comey.
sentences.zh: 解雇科米给他留下了可怕的心理创伤。

sentences.en: Trump himself doesn't love firing people.
sentences.zh: 特朗普本人并不喜欢解雇别人。

sentences.en: And Sessions survives.
sentences.zh: 于是塞申斯留了下来。

sentences.en: And on the calendar, eventually a date emerges where Trump realizes that he can get rid of Sessions.
sentences.zh: 在日程表上，最终出现了一个日期，让特朗普意识到他可以摆脱塞申斯。

sentences.en: And what is that date?
sentences.zh: 那个日期是什么？

sentences.en: The November 2018 midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 2018年11月的中期选举。

sentences.en: And why does that date loom as a deadline after which Trump feels he can finally do what he feels he's been winding up and raring to do for months?
sentences.zh: 为什么这个日期会作为一个最后期限隐现，在此之后，特朗普觉得自己终于可以做他几个月来一直憋着劲、渴望去做的事了？

sentences.en: Trump thinks he can go out and say administrations change cabinet members after midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 特朗普认为他可以公开表示，政府会在中期选举后更换内阁成员。

sentences.en: That's a normal thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件很正常的事。

sentences.en: I'm two years into my time in office.
sentences.zh: 我的任期已经过了两年。

sentences.en: I'm allowed to change my folks up.
sentences.zh: 我有权更换我的人手。

sentences.en: That will be my reason for getting rid of Sessions.
sentences.zh: 这将是我摆脱塞申斯的理由。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, just a few hours after the midterms are over, Sessions gets a call from the White House chief of staff, John Kelly.
sentences.zh: 而在周三，就在中期选举结束几小时后，塞申斯接到了白宫办公厅主任约翰·凯利的电话。

sentences.en: And what does Kelly say to him?
sentences.zh: 凯利对他说什么了？

sentences.en: Kelly says the president wants you to resign.
sentences.zh: 凯利说总统想让你辞职。

sentences.en: So clearly, President Trump did not waste any time firing Sessions.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，特朗普总统解雇塞申斯时没有浪费任何时间。

sentences.en: And I guess I understand why the midterms offers a rationale for doing it now.
sentences.zh: 我想我理解为什么中期选举为现在这样做提供了一个合理解释。

sentences.en: But I guess I'm still confused about why Trump feels the need to fire Sessions at all.
sentences.zh: 但我想我仍然搞不懂为什么特朗普觉得有必要解雇塞申斯。

sentences.en: Because in spite of this original sin, this betrayal of accusing himself, by all accounts, including yours, Sessions operates as an extremely loyal soldier,
sentences.zh: 因为尽管有最初的原罪，有自请回避的背叛，但在各方（包括你）的描述中，塞申斯一直表现得像一个极其忠诚的士兵，

sentences.en: as a cabinet member who does exactly what the president wants.
sentences.zh: 作为一个完全按总统意愿行事的内阁成员。

sentences.en: But what is the president's biggest preoccupation?
sentences.zh: 但总统最关心的头等大事是什么？

sentences.en: The Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 通俄调查。

sentences.en: If he can get a new attorney general in and confirmed,
sentences.zh: 如果他能让一个新的总检察长上任并获得确认，

sentences.en: that attorney general will have oversight of the Russia investigation because they won't have to recuse themselves like Sessions.
sentences.zh: 那个总检察长将对通俄调查拥有监督权，因为他们不必像塞申斯那样回避。

sentences.en: It will be taken out of Rosenstein's hands and given to the new appointee.
sentences.zh: 调查将脱离罗森斯坦的掌控，交由新任命的人负责。

sentences.en: So firing Sessions immediately restores essentially a presidential line of authority straight to Robert Mueller and the Russia investigation by putting in someone who is not recused.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过安抚一个不必回避的人，立即解雇塞申斯基本上恢复了一条直通罗伯特·穆勒和通俄调查的总统权力路线。

sentences.en: And look at who Trump has put in as the acting attorney general.
sentences.zh: 看看特朗普安抚的代理总检察长是谁。

sentences.en: Instead of making Rosenstein the head of the Justice Department, he has taken Sessions's chief of staff, a guy named Matt Whitaker.
sentences.zh: 他没有让罗森斯坦担任司法部负责人，而是启用了塞申斯的办公厅主任，一个名叫马特·惠塔克的家伙。

sentences.en: I can see a scenario where Jeff Sessions is replaced with a recess appointment and that attorney general doesn't fire Bob Mueller,
sentences.zh: 我能想象这样一种情况：杰夫·塞申斯被休会任命的人取代，而这位总检察长没有解雇鲍勃·穆勒，

sentences.en: but he just reduces his budget so low that his his investigation grinds to almost a halt.
sentences.zh: 而是将他的预算砍得如此之低，以至于他的调查几乎陷入停顿。

sentences.en: Matt Whitaker has been a huge critic of the Mueller investigation, going as far as in 2017, writing an op-ed for CNN entitled Mueller's investigation of Trump is going too far.
sentences.zh: 马特·惠塔克一直是穆勒调查的强烈批评者，甚至在2017年为CNN撰写了一篇题为《穆勒对特朗普的调查走得太远了》的评论文章。

sentences.en: So is it possible, Mike, I think this is the question everyone is asking right now, that Jeff Sessions's successor could end the Mueller investigation?
sentences.zh: 迈克，那么有没有可能——我认为这是现在每个人都在问的问题——杰夫·塞申斯的继任者可能会终结穆勒的调查？

sentences.en: It certainly feels like that's within his power.
sentences.zh: 这当然感觉在他的权力范围内。

sentences.en: That is the biggest question coming out of today.
sentences.zh: 那是今天引出的最大问题。

sentences.en: What does this mean for Mueller?
sentences.zh: 这对穆勒意味着什么？

sentences.en: Does it mean business as usual, Mueller is left to take the investigation where it goes?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着一切照旧，穆勒可以继续将调查进行到底？

sentences.en: Does it mean that Mueller's funding is cut or does it mean that Mueller is fired?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着穆勒的资金被削减，还是意味着穆勒被解雇？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: Mike, what happens to Jeff Sessions now and what kind of threat does he pose to the president, given the role he has played in the entire Russia situation?
sentences.zh: 迈克，杰夫·塞申斯现在会怎么样？鉴他在整个通俄事件中所扮演的角色，他对总统构成了什么样的威胁？

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions was and is a chief witness against the president in the obstruction investigation.
sentences.zh: 在妨碍司法调查中，杰夫·塞申斯过去是、现在也是针对总统的核心证人。

sentences.en: Sessions was interviewed at length by Mueller's team earlier this year about all of the things, the efforts to get him to not recuse himself, to unrecuse himself, to fire him,
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，穆勒的团队曾就所有事情对塞申斯进行了长时间的盘问，包括要求他不要回避、要求他取消回避、要求解雇他的种种努力，

sentences.en: everything related to what the president did to him on the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 以及与总统在通俄调查中对他的所作所为有关的一切。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: That seems especially important, given what just happened on Wednesday right before Sessions was fired,
sentences.zh: 考虑到周三、就在塞申斯被解雇前不久刚刚发生的事情，这似乎显得格外重要，

sentences.en: which was the outcome of the midterms and the Democrats taking control of the House.
sentences.zh: 那就是中期选举的结果以及民主党夺取了众议院的控制权。

sentences.en: Because the timing now looks quite problematic for the president.
sentences.zh: 因为现在这个时机对总统来说显得相当棘手。

sentences.en: Wouldn't firing Sessions or replacing him with someone who could fire Rosenstein or even Mueller be exactly the sort of fuel that Democrats could use now that they have the majority in the House to begin an investigation or something even more extreme like impeachment when it comes to the president and the Russia investigation?
sentences.zh: 解雇塞申斯，或者用一个可能会解雇罗森斯坦甚至穆勒的人取而代之，难道不会正好成为民主党人现在可以利用的弹药吗？既然他们已经掌握了众议院多数席位，就可以对总统及其通俄调查展开调查，甚至是采取诸如弹劾之类更极端的行动？

sentences.en: The Democrats already have enough to do a wide ranging obstruction investigation into the president.
sentences.zh: 民主党人已经有足够多的材料来对总统展开范围广泛的妨碍司法调查了。

sentences.en: The question is, if Trump were to have Mueller fired and this truly was part of a larger scheme,
sentences.zh: 问题是，如果特朗普真的解雇了穆勒，而这确实是一个更大阴谋的一部分，

sentences.en: does that push public opinion so far that the Democrats who are sort of divided about whether they should try and impeach Trump move more aggressively in that direction?
sentences.zh: 这会不会把公众舆论推向如此极端的程度，以至于原本在是否应该试图弹劾特朗普的问题上意见不一的民主党人，会朝着那个方向采取更激进的行动？

sentences.en: But if Mueller is fired, isn't it the case that no one ends up seeing the result of his investigation or am I missing something?
sentences.zh: 但如果穆勒被解雇，难道不会出现没有人能看到他的调查结果的情况吗？还是说我漏掉了什么？

sentences.en: That is a potential outcome where Mueller's findings could be kept under wraps and from the Congress and depriving Democrats of important evidence that they would need,
sentences.zh: 这是一种潜在的结果，穆勒的调查结果可能会被秘而不宣，不让国会知道，从而剥夺民主党人所需的关键证据，

sentences.en: at least politically, to make an argument that unbiased investigators have found that the president obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 至少在政治上，无法以此论证公正无私的调查人员已经发现总统妨碍了司法公正。

sentences.en: That is the fear of the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 这就是民主党人的担忧。

sentences.en: But as of today, it's not the reality.
sentences.zh: 但截至今天，这还不是现实。

sentences.en: And Trump could have, if he wanted, to have fired Mueller months ago and clearly doesn't think he has the political capital to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普愿意，他几个月前就可以解雇穆勒，但他显然认为自己没有足够的政治资本这样做。

sentences.en: So is today that different?
sentences.zh: 所以今天真的有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: We're certainly potentially headed in a different direction.
sentences.zh: 我们当然有可能正朝着一个不同的方向前进。

sentences.en: Whatever the case is,
sentences.zh: 无论如何，

sentences.en: we're in a far different place on Jeff Sessions and Donald Trump than we were in 2016 when they came together to put on red Make America Great Again hats at a rally in Alabama.
sentences.zh: 我们在杰夫·塞申斯和唐纳德·特朗普身上的立场，已经与2016年他们在阿拉巴马州的一次集会上戴上红色的“让美国再次伟大”帽子时大不相同了。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 迈克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们不胜感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the Department of Justice said that the acting attorney general, Matt Whitaker,
sentences.zh: 周三晚间，司法部表示，代理总检察长马特·惠塔克

sentences.en: would immediately begin to oversee the special counsel investigation in place of Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein.
sentences.zh: 将立即开始接替副总检察长罗德·罗森斯坦监督特别检察官调查。

sentences.en: But the Times reports that because Whitaker has expressed opinions about the investigation, he could be asked by Justice Department ethics advisors to recuse himself,
sentences.zh: 但《时报》报道称，由于惠塔克曾对该调查发表过意见，他可能会被司法部道德顾问要求回避，

sentences.en: just as Sessions did.
sentences.zh: 就像塞申斯那样。

sentences.en: If that were to happen, Rosenstein would continue to be in charge of the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，罗森斯坦将继续负责穆勒的调查。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Thanks to you, tomorrow will be a new day in America.
sentences.zh: 多亏了你们，明天将是美国崭新的一天。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, with almost all the votes counted from the midterm elections, Democrats gained control of 27 new seats in the House of Representatives,
sentences.zh: 周三，随着中期选举的选票几乎全部清点完毕，民主党人在众议院赢得了27个新席位，

sentences.en: giving them at least a four-member majority over Republicans that may grow by 10 seats in races that have yet to be called.
sentences.zh: 这让他们对共和党人形成了至少四个席位的多数优势，在尚未宣布结果的选区中，这一优势可能还会增加10个席位。

sentences.en: Today is more than about Democrats and Republicans.
sentences.zh: 今天不仅仅关乎民主党和共和党。

sentences.en: It's about restoring the Constitution's checks and balances to the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 它关乎恢复宪法对特朗普政府的制衡。

sentences.en: In the Senate, Republicans were on track to increase their majority by two seats, and possibly three.
sentences.zh: 在参议院，共和党人有望将他们的多数优势增加两个席位，甚至可能是三个。

sentences.en: Perhaps, looks like, I would think, Speaker Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 也许，看起来，依我之见，众议院议长南希·佩洛西。

sentences.en: And I give her a lot of credit.
sentences.zh: 我非常赞赏她。

sentences.en: She works very hard, and she's worked long and hard.
sentences.zh: 她工作非常努力，而且长期以来一直辛勤工作。

sentences.en: I give her a great deal of credit for what she's done and what she's accomplished.
sentences.zh: 对于她所做的事情和她取得的成就，我给予她极高的评价。

sentences.en: Hopefully we can all work together next year to continue delivering for the American people.
sentences.zh: 希望我们明年能够齐心协力，继续为美国人民兑现承诺。

sentences.en: That outcome prompted President Trump on Wednesday to simultaneously reach out to House Democrats with an offer of cooperation and issue a threat of retaliation if they use their new majority to begin investigating his administration.
sentences.zh: 这一结果促使特朗普总统在周三一方面向众议院民主党人抛出橄榄枝表示愿意合作，另一方面又发出报复威胁，如果他们利用新的多数席位开始调查他的政府的话。

sentences.en: If they start investigating you, can you compartmentalize that and still continue to work with them for the benefit of the rest of the country?
sentences.zh: 如果他们开始调查你，你能把这部分隔离开来，并继续与他们合作以造福全国其他地方吗？

sentences.en: Are you, are all bets off?
sentences.zh: 你是说，一切都免谈了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: If they do that, then it's just, all it is is a warlike posture.
sentences.zh: 如果他们那样做，那么这纯粹、仅仅是一种好战的姿态。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 还有。

sentences.en: But I'm here tonight to tell you, votes remain to be counted.
sentences.zh: 但我今晚在这里告诉你们，还有选票等待清点。

sentences.en: There are voices that are waiting to be heard.
sentences.zh: 还有声音等待被倾听。

sentences.en: And we believe our chance for a stronger Georgia is just within reach.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，我们建立一个更强大的佐治亚州的机会就在眼前。

sentences.en: In one of the most closely watched races in the country, the Georgia governor's race, between Democrat Stacey Abrams and Republican Brian Kemp, no winner has been declared.
sentences.zh: 在全国最受关注的竞选之一——佐治亚州州长竞选（民主党人斯黛西·艾布拉姆斯与共和党人布赖恩·坎普对决）中，尚未宣布获胜者。

sentences.en: But we cannot seize it until all voices are heard.
sentences.zh: 但在所有声音都被倾听之前，我们不能妄下定论。

sentences.en: And I promise you tonight, we're going to make sure that every vote is counted.
sentences.zh: 我今晚向你们保证，我们确保每一张选票都被清点。

sentences.en: Kemp leads Abrams by more than 60,000 votes.
sentences.zh: 坎普领先艾布拉姆斯6万多票。

sentences.en: But Abrams believes that there are enough uncounted ballots to force Kemp below 50 percent of the vote, which, under Georgia law, would force a runoff election.
sentences.zh: 但艾布拉姆斯认为，还有足够的未清点选票，可以将坎普的得票率压低至50%以下，根据佐治亚州法律，这将迫使进行决选。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严格控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.zh: 请在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
